companyFocus.name: Dreame
companyFocus.role: Consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch164. Dreame pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. X50 Ultra, L40 Ultra, Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller are four separate current models. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: Dreame is a consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer whose current US range includes the X50 Ultra, L40 Ultra, Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller.

Its robot vacuum lines use different mop systems: multi-mop switching on the Matrix10 Ultra, a self-rinsing roller mop on the Aqua10 Ultra Roller, MopExtend RoboSwing on the L40 Ultra and a retractable VersaLift sensor on the X50 Ultra.
The reviewed pages publish 11,000 Pa suction for the L40 Ultra, 20,000 Pa for the X50 Ultra and 30,000 Pa for the Matrix10 Ultra and Aqua10 Ultra Roller.
Battery capacity is 5,200 mAh for the L40 Ultra and 6,400 mAh for the other three; the X50 Ultra page cites up to 220 min of cleaning and 205 m2 per charge, the L40 Ultra page up to 194 min.
The reviewed pages publish no dB noise rating, absolute charging time, payload or IP rating; prices are dated US sale observations against regular prices.
